I will keep this beans plot mostly the way I managed it before, because cash is tight and this land is rented, so I do not want to spend too much and then lose if the season goes badly. I do intercrop it, so I will use my own saved seed and a little manure I can get nearby, but I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this plot this season. I will spray for pests because beans can suffer badly if I leave them, I will depend on rain only, and my family will do most of the work with a few hired hands when we are busy.
